name: skill-router
description: On every prompt, asks Jev which skills fit, shows them ranked above the prompt, and has the model load those over the threshold.

threshold.title: Threshold
threshold.description: Probability (0 to 1) a skill needs to be shown and loaded.

max_skills.title: Max skills
max_skills.description: How many skills to load per prompt at most, highest first.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for Jev before sending the prompt without skills.
